abstract: We report a patient with a disorder of sexual differentiation who presented with a 46,XY karyotype, absent internal Müllerian ducts, a vaginal pouch, hypospadias, and bilateral cryptorchidism with a gonadoblastoma in one testis. A human chorionic gonadotropin stimulation test and tissue 5-alpha-reductase and androgen receptor assays were normal. Except for the absence of internal Müllerian ducts, this patient most closely resembles the disorder of dysgenetic male pseudohermaphroditism (DMP). On this basis, we hypothesize that the internal Müllerian ducts in DMP may manifest anywhere along a spectrum that extends from normal to complete absence of structures depending on the degree of gonadal dysgenesis. This case also illustrates the importance of testicular biopsy in patients with dysgenetic testes because of the high likelihood of germ cell neoplasms in these gonads.
abstract_ja: 46,XY核型、内性器のミュラー管欠如、膣盲端、尿道下裂を呈し、両側停留精巣を伴い、一側の精巣に性腺芽腫を認めた性分化疾患患者を報告する。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)刺激試験と、組織の5α-還元酵素およびアンドロゲン受容体の測定は正常であった。内性器のミュラー管がないことを除けば、この患者は異形成性男性仮性半陰陽（DMP）に最も近い。これに基づき、DMPにおけるミュラー管の所見は、性腺異形成の程度に応じて正常から完全欠如までのスペクトラムのどこかに現れうると仮説を立てる。本症例はまた、異形成性精巣を有する患者では胚細胞腫瘍の可能性が高いため、精巣生検の重要性を示している。
